# ECN-2026-034 Change notice - Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1

Rev E  
Plant: P1, line P1-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-RR01

Related documents: SB-1025, SOP-P1-L1-03, SOP-P1-L1-05

## Reason for change

This engineering change notice updates operating and inspection boundaries for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill identified as EQ-P1-L1-RR01. Background: recent production trials and nonconformance reviews identified rings with outer diameters approaching the current practical limits of the mill mechanical envelope and tooling clearances. Analysis of forming results, tooling wear patterns, and handling constraints concluded that a clarified maximum ring outer diameter limit is required to ensure consistent forming quality, protect drive and roll train components, and maintain safe handling practices in the hot forge environment.

The maximum ring outer diameter for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) is 1240 mm. This value is declared as the formal limit for all planning, scheduling, and quality acceptance for rings routed to this piece of equipment. The change is intended to reduce variability in forming, eliminate repeat adjustments that accelerate tooling wear, and align production schedules and handling procedures with documented equipment capability. This also reduces risk of unplanned downtime caused by interference in the roll path or improper handling of oversized blanks.

## Affected items

- EQ-P1-L1-RR01 operating instructions and job setup sheets that reference dimensional limits.  
- Work orders and process routings that assign rings with outer diameters to EQ-P1-L1-RR01.  
- Tooling selection lists and spare parts staging that support roll profiles used near the declared limit.  
- Material handling procedures used for transfer to and from EQ-P1-L1-RR01, including lift planning and ergonomic controls.  
- Quality acceptance criteria and inspection records that verify ring outer diameter prior to roll entry.

Affected process documents to be updated: SOP-P1-L1-03 and SOP-P1-L1-05. Design bulletin SB-1025 should be referenced for engineering constraints and component drawings during any tooling changes or layout adjustments.

Examples of routing impact: rings with nominal outer diameters at or below the declared limit may proceed to EQ-P1-L1-RR01 following SOP-P1-L1-03. Rings with outer diameters beyond the declared limit must be routed to alternative forming assets or require engineering disposition per SB-1025 prior to scheduling.

## Implementation

Scope: enforce maximum outer diameter limit within planning, pre-rolling inspection, setup, and production execution for EQ-P1-L1-RR01. Key implementation steps follow.

- Update process documents: revise SOP-P1-L1-03 and SOP-P1-L1-05 to include the declared maximum ring outer diameter for EQ-P1-L1-RR01 and include checklist items for verifying ring outer diameter at incoming inspection. Reference SB-1025 for any required engineering evaluation if a part exceeds the limit.

- Pre-rolling inspection: inspectors shall verify incoming ring outer diameter against the declared maximum prior to release to the mill. Measurement records shall be captured on the job traveler and retained with the work order.

- Job setup and tooling: setup personnel shall confirm tooling selection and roll profiles are compatible with rings at the declared outer diameter. Any tooling degradation observed during initial forming of rings near the declared limit must be documented in the tooling log and reported to maintenance.

- Handling and transfer controls: material handling teams shall follow updated lift and transfer procedures for rings sized at or near the declared limit. Handling checks shall be recorded on the transfer checklist.

- Quality acceptance: final inspection shall verify formed ring outer diameter meets drawing specifications and confirm no damage attributable to exceeding equipment capability. Nonconformances shall be processed per quality procedures with reference to this ECN and SB-1025.

- Training: affected operators, inspectors, schedulers, and maintenance staff shall receive training on the revised SOP content and the declared maximum outer diameter. Training attendance and competency checks shall be recorded in employee training records.

- Scheduling and routing enforcement: production planning shall apply the declared limit as a hard constraint in job assignment tools. Any exception request shall follow an engineering disposition process that references SB-1025.

Records to keep: updated SOP-P1-L1-03 and SOP-P1-L1-05 controlled copies; job traveler measurement records showing incoming outer diameter verification; tooling logs noting any wear or adjustment when processing rings near the declared limit; transfer and handling checklists; training attendance records; engineering disposition records when exceptions are granted referencing SB-1025.

Timeline: changes will be entered into the document control system and distributed to impacted teams. Implementation monitoring will occur for an initial run period to verify compliance and to capture any unforeseen impacts on throughput or tooling life.

## Approvals

Approvals required prior to implementation: operations manager for P1-L1, quality manager, maintenance manager, and the engineering owner listed in SB-1025. Final approval will confirm that SOP-P1-L1-03 and SOP-P1-L1-05 have been revised and that training and record capture mechanisms are in place.

Approval records to be maintained with this ECN: signed approval sheet stored in the document control repository and cross-referenced to the revised SOPs and to SB-1025. Engineering disposition records for any approved exceptions must cite SB-1025 and be filed with the work order and quality records.

Signatures will confirm acceptance of the declared maximum ring outer diameter and that operations, maintenance, and quality are aligned on inspection, handling, and tooling practices for EQ-P1-L1-RR01.
